title: The Cost of Power
summary: Ha-Jun's excessive blood manipulation causes acute mana exhaustion and severe anemia. While recovering in a hideout, Kuro reveals the second basic relic—the Bone of the Forgotten—and the hidden cost of sovereign authority.

panels.shot: neon rainy seoul alley wide shot
panels.action: Rain hammers down on neon signboards in a dark alleyway; steam rises from restaurant exhaust vents.
panels.prose_en: Rain hammers down on neon signboards in a dark alleyway; steam rises from restaurant exhaust vents.
panels.prose_hi: Andheri gali mein neon sinbordon par baarish ka hathauda gir raha hai; restraan ke nikas dwaron se bhaap uthti hai.

panels.action: A faded grey laundry van sits with wipers running softly, headlights switched off.
panels.prose_en: A faded grey laundry van sits with wipers running softly, headlights switched off.
panels.prose_hi: Ek fiki grey laundry van mein wiper dhire-dhire chal rahe han, headlights band han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun drops silently from the fire escape landing right into the open sliding door.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun drops silently from the fire escape landing right into the open sliding door.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun chupchap aag se bachne ke liye khule sliding darvaje mein utarta hai.

panels.action: The moment his feet touch the van floor, Ha-Jun's knees give out completely and he falls face-first onto foam mats.
panels.prose_en: The moment his feet touch the van floor, Ha-Jun's knees give out completely and he falls face-first onto foam mats.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi uske pair van ke farsh ko chhute han, ha-jun ke ghutne puri tarah se chhoot jaate hain aur wah foam mat par aamne-samne gir jata hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae drops his tablet and lunges forward to catch Ha-Jun's shoulders: 'Ha-Jun! Kya hua?!'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: HA-JUN!! Tumhara shareer itna thanda kyu hai?!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae drops his tablet and lunges forward to catch Ha-Jun's shoulders: 'Ha-Jun! Kya hua?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apna tablet girata hai aur ha-jun ke kandhon ko pakadne ke liye aage badhta hai: 'ha-jun! kya hua?!'

panels.shot: extreme close-up on ha-jun pale face
panels.action: Ha-Jun's lips are completely white and bloodless, cold sweat plastering hair to his forehead, shivering uncontrollably.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's lips are completely white and bloodless, cold sweat plastering hair to his forehead, shivering uncontrollably.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke honth puri tarah se safed aur raktheen han, uske mathe par baalon mein thanda pasina aa raha hai aur wah aniyantrit roop se kamp raha hai.

panels.shot: ring of hollow blood pulsing faintly
panels.action: The obsidian ring on his finger emits a dull, thready crimson pulse, as if starved for energy.
panels.prose_en: The obsidian ring on his finger emits a dull, thready crimson pulse, as if starved for energy.
panels.prose_hi: Uski ungli par obsidian anguthi ek sust, dhagedar lal rang ki naadi ka utsarjan karti hai, jaise ki urja ki bhookhi ho.

panels.action: Ha-Jun coughs hoarsely into a cotton rag, wheezing as his chest heaves painfully.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun coughs hoarsely into a cotton rag, wheezing as his chest heaves painfully.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun rui ke fahe mein jor-jor se khansta hai aur uski chhati mein dard ke saath gharghrahat hoti hai.

panels.action: Kuro tilts his feathered head, inspecting Ha-Jun with strict demonic clinical detachment.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Maine kaha tha... Insaani shareer Sovereign ki weaponized blood capacity ke liye abhi tayar nahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro tilts his feathered head, inspecting Ha-Jun with strict demonic clinical detachment.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne pankh wale sir ko jhukata hai, sakht rakshasi naidanik ​​tukdi ke saath ha-jun ka nirikshan karta hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae presses his fingers to Ha-Jun's carotid artery, eyes wide with medical alarm.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Blood pressure dangerously low hai... Hemoglobin crash ho gaya! Ise hospital le jana hoga!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae presses his fingers to Ha-Jun's carotid artery, eyes wide with medical alarm.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apni ungaliyon ko ha-jun ki caroted dhamni par dabata hai, medical alarm se uski aankhen chaudi ho jaati han.

panels.action: Kuro snaps his beak: 'Hospital? Tum chahte ho Bureau ke doctor iska dissection karein?!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Hospital bilkul nahi! Uska DNA ordinary humans se match nahi karega!

panels.prose_en: Kuro snaps his beak: 'Hospital? Tum chahte ho Bureau ke doctor iska dissection karein?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apni chonch kati: 'aspatal? tum chahte ho bureau ke doctor iska disection karen?!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun weakly raising hand to stop min-jae
panels.action: Ha-Jun's trembling fingers grip Min-Jae's wrist: 'Kuro sahi keh raha hai... Hospital nahi.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's trembling fingers grip Min-Jae's wrist: 'Kuro sahi keh raha hai... Hospital nahi.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki kampati ungaliyan min-je ki kalai pakadti han: 'kuro sahi kah raha hai... aspataal nahin.'

panels.action: Kuro explains: 'High-protein red meat, iron electrolytes, aur demon mana absorption.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Tumhari marrow ordinary insaan se das guna tez blood cells banayegi agar fuel mile.

panels.prose_en: Kuro explains: 'High-protein red meat, iron electrolytes, aur demon mana absorption.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro batate han: 'ucch protein lal mans, lauh electrolits, aur danav man avshoshan.'

panels.action: Min-Jae immediately tears open a thermal cooler box containing raw beef steaks and iron hydration pouches.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae immediately tears open a thermal cooler box containing raw beef steaks and iron hydration pouches.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne turant kacche beef stake aur iron hydration pouch wale thermal cooler box ko faad diya.

panels.action: Ha-Jun greedily gulps down three metallic-tasting iron-rich nutritional packs in seconds.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun greedily gulps down three metallic-tasting iron-rich nutritional packs in seconds.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun lalach se secondon mein dhatu-swad wale lauh-samriddh poshan sambandhi teen pack nigal jata hai.

panels.action: Within moments, faint pink vitality creeps back into Ha-Jun's lips and fingertips as mana metabolizes the iron.
panels.prose_en: Within moments, faint pink vitality creeps back into Ha-Jun's lips and fingertips as mana metabolizes the iron.
panels.prose_hi: Kuch hi kshanon men, halki gulabi jeevan shakti ha-jun ke hothon aur ungaliyon mein wapas aa jaati hai kyonki man lohe ka chayapachay karta hai.

panels.action: A glowing status box appears with yellow warning borders.

dialogue.text:
[SYSTEM WARNING: BIOLOGICAL STRAIN DETECTED]
Physical Vessel Durability: 18% (CRITICAL)
Bloodline Synchronization capped at 28.5% until bone density and skeletal framework are reinforced.

panels.prose_en: A glowing status box appears with yellow warning borders.
panels.prose_hi: Pile rang ki chetavani seemaon ke saath ek chamakta status box dikhai deta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun reads the warning: 'Bone density and skeletal framework...?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mera shareer mere blood pressure ko jhelne ke liye bohot kamzor hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reads the warning: 'Bone density and skeletal framework...?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne chetavani padhi: 'asthi ghanatv aur kankal dhancha...?'.

panels.action: Kuro hops onto Ha-Jun's knee: 'Yahi wajah hai ki First Sovereign ne Relics ko sequence mein banaya tha.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Pehle khoon... Phir haddi. Next relic hai: 'Bone of the Forgotten'.

panels.prose_en: Kuro hops onto Ha-Jun's knee: 'Yahi wajah hai ki First Sovereign ne Relics ko sequence mein banaya tha.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ha-jun ke ghutne par baith jata hai: 'yahi vajah hai ki first sovereign ne avsheshon ko sequence mein banaya tha.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun rubs his aching forearm bones: 'Bone of the Forgotten kya karti hai?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Woh meri haddiyon ko reinforce karegi?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rubs his aching forearm bones: 'Bone of the Forgotten kya karti hai?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni dukhti baanh ki haddiyon ko ragadata hai: 'bon off the forgotten kya karti hai?'.

panels.action: Kuro explains: 'Woh ancient sovereign guard ka skeletal relic hai. Tumhare skeletal system ko diamond-hard armor mein convert karega.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Khoon ka pressure kitna bhi badhe, tumhari haddiyan kabhi nahi tootengi.

panels.prose_en: Kuro explains: 'Woh ancient sovereign guard ka skeletal relic hai. Tumhare skeletal system ko diamond-hard armor mein convert karega.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro batate han: 'vah prachin samprabhu rakshak ka kankal avashesh hai. tumhare kankal tantra ko heere jaisa kathor kavach mein parivartit karega.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun looks out the rain-streaked window: 'Woh kahan milegi?'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks out the rain-streaked window: 'Woh kahan milegi?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun baarish se ghiri khidki se bahar dekhta hai: 'vo kahan milegi?'

panels.action: Min-Jae cross-references geological anomaly records on his encrypted laptop.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Incheon ki purani abandoned limestone quarry... Wahan 1980 se zero seismic activity thi, lekin ab ajeeb vibration aa rahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae cross-references geological anomaly records on his encrypted laptop.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apne encrypted laptop par bhuvaigyanik visangati record ko cross-referance karta hai.

panels.action: Kuro nods: 'Wahin hai. The Catacomb of the Forgotten.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Lekin warning sun lo: use ek ancient Guardian protect kar raha hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro nods: 'Wahin hai. The Catacomb of the Forgotten.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne sir hilaya: 'vahin hai. bhule hue ka catakomb.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun sits up and firmly tightens the laces of his combat boots.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sits up and firmly tightens the laces of his combat boots.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun baithta hai aur apne ladaku jooton ke feeton ko majbuti se kasta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking at min-jae with resolve
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes burn with dual violet-crimson rings: 'Main kamzor nahi reh sakta. Incheon chalo.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Incheon quarry ka rasta pakdo, Min-Jae. Humein subah se pehle pahunchna hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes burn with dual violet-crimson rings: 'Main kamzor nahi reh sakta. Incheon chalo.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki aankhen dohre bangni-lal rang ke chhallon se jalti han: 'main kamzor nahin rah sakta. inchiyon chalo.'

panels.action: Min-Jae nods firmly, gripping the gear stick and slamming his foot onto the accelerator.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Seatbelt baandh lo. Route clear hai.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae nods firmly, gripping the gear stick and slamming his foot onto the accelerator.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne dridhta se sir hilaya, gear stick ko pakda aur accelator par apna pair patak diya.

panels.action: The grey van merges onto the wet, reflection-streaked Olympic Expressway through blinding rain.
panels.prose_en: The grey van merges onto the wet, reflection-streaked Olympic Expressway through blinding rain.
panels.prose_hi: Gre van tez baarish ke madhyam se geele, pratibimb-dharidar olympic expressway par vilin ho jaati hai.

panels.action: Kuro's eyes glow crimson in the dashboard darkness, muttering to himself.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Guardian aasan nahi hoga... Woh First Sovereign ka sabse faithful general tha.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's eyes glow crimson in the dashboard darkness, muttering to himself.
panels.prose_hi: Dashbord ke andhere mein kuro ki aankhen lal rang ki chamakti han, wah khud se badbada raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun staring at his fist in reflection
panels.action: Ha-Jun gazes at his own clenched fist in the glass, the obsidian ring softly glowing red.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chahe meri saari haddiyan toot jayein... main apne bhai ko dhoondh kar rahunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun gazes at his own clenched fist in the glass, the obsidian ring softly glowing red.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sheeshe mein apni band mutthi ko dekhta hai, obsidian ring dheere se lal chamak rahi hai.
